Requirement: The system shall hold each controlled vocabulary as a configurable reference table, not as hard-coded values or folder names.
Each vocabulary entry shall carry a code, a display name, an owner, a status and an effective date.
Each vocabulary shall be version-controlled, and every change to it shall be subject to change control and recorded in the audit trail.
Where a vocabulary exists for a field, the system shall not permit free-text entry in that field.
The system shall support initial import of all vocabularies from GMG-QMS-LOG-0007 and shall reconcile against it on demand.
The system shall enforce that a TYPE code is valid only for the domains in which it is approved. TYPE sets differ by domain and are not universal.
An entity code, once allocated, shall never be reassigned to a different legal entity. Retiring an entity shall retire its code permanently; the code
A new legal entity shall receive a new stable code. The system shall reject allocation of a code that is retired or in use.
The system shall record entity status — active, retired — with effective dates, and shall resolve historical references to a retired entity without am
The system shall not permit two vocabulary entries in the same set to share a code, or to differ only by case or by leading or trailing separators.
The storage location of an object shall not encode its classification. Entity, domain, type, lifecycle state and record class shall be metadata attrib
The system shall derive a display path and an export path from metadata on demand.
Changing a classification attribute shall not move, copy or duplicate the stored object, and shall not invalidate any link or reference to it.
Links and references to an object shall remain valid for the life of the object regardless of any change to its classification or lifecycle state.
The system shall generate filesystem-compatible export paths with a configurable root, and shall warn where a generated absolute path would exceed 255
Export path segments shall be restricted to ASCII letters, digits, hyphen and underscore. Full Unicode shall be supported in metadata and in display n
The system shall be capable of producing a complete filesystem export of any scope, reproducing the approved folder topology, for archive or regulator
Lifecycle shall be an attribute of the document and shall be changed by a state transition, never by moving or copying a file.
The system shall implement lifecycle as a state machine with explicitly permitted transitions. Transitions not defined shall be impossible, not merely
Each transition shall require the role authorised for it, and shall capture evidence, reason, actor and timestamp.
The system shall enforce that exactly one version of a document code is in the Effective state at any time.
On a version becoming Effective, the system shall transition the prior Effective version to Superseded automatically and atomically.
Superseded and Retired shall be distinct, separately reportable states. Superseded means replaced by a later version; Retired means withdrawn without
The system shall support a documented state for content that is void or withdrawn before ever becoming effective, or shall map such content explicitly
The system shall prevent a document from entering Effective without a completed approval record and an applied electronic signature.
Version identifiers shall be system-controlled. Users shall not be able to set or edit a version number directly.
The system shall distinguish controlled documents from quality records as separate object classes with separate rules.
A quality record shall not be assigned a controlled-document lifecycle state.
A completed quality record shall not be overwritten or deleted by any role, including any administrative role.
Correction of a completed record shall be by controlled correction or append only, preserving the original content and recording reason, actor and tim
A quality record shall carry a mandatory record class from the approved list.
A quality record shall not carry a document version unless its record type has an approved revision lifecycle.
The system shall support a parent-child relationship between a controlled document and its components — annexes, figures, checklists and attachments.
A component shall be reachable from its parent and shall identify its parent.
The system shall support both models by configuration: components versioned with the parent, and components versioned independently. The applicable ru
Where components version with the parent, a parent transition shall carry its components with it.
The system shall prevent a component from being made Effective independently where the configured rule is that it versions with its parent.

Document code uniqueness shall be enforced by the system at the point of allocation.
The system shall allocate document codes and permanent UIDs from controlled sequences, and shall not permit manual allocation.
On ingestion the system shall compute and store a cryptographic hash of every object.
On ingestion the system shall detect content already present by hash and shall require an explicit disposition rather than creating a second instance.
The system shall exclude operating-system metadata artefacts from ingestion by configurable rule, and shall report what it excluded so that counts rec
The system shall reject or quarantine any object that cannot be assigned a valid entity, domain, type and record class, rather than assigning a defaul
Access shall be granted to roles, never to named individuals by exception.
The system shall implement all approved permission profiles, each expressing read, create, modify, approve or transition, delete or dispose, and exter
Effective permission shall be determined by the combination of entity, zone, domain and record class, not by storage location.
No permission profile shall be capable of granting overwrite or deletion of a completed quality record.
The system shall enforce negative access: a role outside the scope of a profile shall be denied, and the denial shall be recorded.
The system shall support joiner, mover and leaver processing, removing access on leaving and requiring recertification on moving.
The system shall support periodic access review and produce evidence of it.
External sharing shall be possible only through an approved route, shall be time-limited, and shall be recorded.
Entity segregation shall be enforced such that a role scoped to one legal entity cannot read another entity's records except through an approved cross
Legal hold shall be a single object applied to a matter, capable of spanning entities, domains and record classes.
Legal hold shall override retention, disposition and deletion for every object it covers.
No role, including any administrative role, shall be able to delete or dispose of an object under legal hold.
The system shall report every object under a given hold, completely, from a single query.
Retention schedules shall be metadata-driven, applied by record class and entity.
Disposition shall require approval, shall be recorded, and shall never be a user action.
The system shall report objects eligible for disposition and shall not dispose of them automatically.
The system shall maintain an audit trail that is attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original and accurate.
The audit trail shall record creation, modification, lifecycle transition, permission change, hold application and release, disposition, and every den
The audit trail shall not be editable or erasable by any role.
The audit trail shall be retained for at least the retention period of the record it describes.
The audit trail shall be reviewable and exportable without vendor intervention.
Electronic signatures, where used, shall be linked to their records and shall capture signer, date, time and meaning of signature.
Users shall be able to search on any classification attribute and any combination of them.
The system shall provide multiple navigation views over the same objects — by entity, by domain, by type, by lifecycle state and by record class — wit
Search results shall be filtered by the user's effective permissions, and the existence of records the user may not read shall not be disclosed.
The system shall retrieve the current Effective version of a document code in a single step.
The system shall present the complete version history of a document code, including Superseded and Retired versions, to authorised roles.
The system shall ingest objects together with pre-recorded source hashes and shall verify each hash after ingestion.
The system shall produce a reconciliation report of expected against actual, itemising every discrepancy.
The system shall support loading objects in a held or unclassified state where classification is not yet determined, and shall prevent their operation
The system shall not assign a default classification to an object whose classification is undetermined.
Migration shall be reversible. The system shall support removal of a migrated set and restoration of the prior state within an agreed recovery objecti
The source estate shall not be modified or deleted by any migration activity.
Where an approved system of record exists for a class of data — ERP, CRM, HRIS, RIM, PV or QMS — this system shall hold a link or a controlled read-on
The system shall record, per record class, which system is authoritative.
Any export produced by the system shall be marked as a copy and shall not be presentable as the authoritative record.
On go-live the folder tree shall cease to be maintained independently and shall be either generated from this system or formally retired.
The system and its data shall be owned by the organisation, not by an individual account, and shall survive the departure of any individual.
Recovery point objective shall not exceed 4 hours and recovery time objective shall not exceed 8 hours for the production system. A full restoration t
Retrieval of any single object by document code shall complete within 3 seconds at the 95th percentile under normal load.
The system shall accept individual objects of at least 500 MB and shall support the formats present in the estate: docx, xlsx, pdf, png, txt, and shal
Batch ingestion shall sustain at least 1,000 objects per hour with hash verification.
The system shall provide monitoring and alerting for failed ingestion, failed backup, failed transition and permission-change events.
The system shall integrate with the organisation's identity provider for authentication and group membership.
The system shall support at minimum 50,000 objects, 500 GB of content and 100 concurrent users, with headroom for 5 years of growth at the observed ra
The system shall not impose a limit on classification depth that is shallower than the approved model requires.
Availability, support and escalation shall be defined in a service level agreement.
Data shall be exportable in an open, documented format on termination, including metadata and audit trail.
The system shall expose a documented API sufficient to search and retrieve content and metadata under the caller's own permissions.
Programmatic and AI access shall be authenticated as the requesting user and constrained by that user's effective permission profile. Service accounts
Every programmatic and AI retrieval shall be recorded in the audit trail with the requesting user, the query and the objects returned.
The supplier shall be assessed and the assessment recorded before contract.
The system shall be validated in accordance with GMG's computerised system validation approach, proportionate to its GxP classification.
Installation, operational and performance qualification shall be executed against approved protocols by a named executor with independent review.
A traceability matrix shall link every requirement in this specification to at least one executed test.
Negative testing shall be executed for every permission profile and for completed-record overwrite prevention.
No requirement in this specification shall be closed by vendor assertion alone.
